verdict.rationale: Runtime-to-model-file compatibility is a fair question for a local LLM runner like LM Studio, but the evidence pack never covers runtime upgrades, version pinning, or compatibility guarantees for previously downloaded quantized files. The only compatibility-related item is a community report about a minimum macOS version for loading models, which is an OS requirement, not a runtime-upgrade compatibility signal.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether upgrading the runtime can break compatibility with previously downloaded quantized model files
